items.Sentence: Raw wastewater enters the Facility by way of two grinder pumps.
From the headworks, influent enters the primary clarifier...
influent enters the primary clarifier in the center...
Effluent from primary clarifier is fed by gravity into a fixed film reactor sump, where it is then pumped over the fixed film reactor...
the remainder is pumped to two secondary sedimentation tanks.
Effluent from the secondary sedimentation tanks is disinfected with sodium hypochlorite
and then dechlorinated with sodium bisulfite.
Biosolids ... are pumped back to the primary clarifier and ultimately to the anaerobic digester.
trucking the material off-site for further processing.
